svg.text: Five MP4s in; a queryable warehouse out. Measured creative features, a synthetic audience panel, and two HTTP services.
ffmpeg → cache/<sha256>/ : frames @ 4 Hz + 16 kHz mono WAV
one interface · independent · manifest skips unchanged work
one Parquet per extractor, per creative
built by transforms/*.sql — raw views → dimensions → spine → marts
committed — readable with no Docker, no build
generated from the warehouse and the apps
audience/generate.py — the response is a function of the measured creative
No API ever writes to warehouse.duckdb — ingest lands files, a batch load folds them in.
